## Equations

A numbered equation:

$$
y = mx + b
$$ {#eq-line}

A system of equations, numbered as one:

$$
\begin{aligned}
u &= px, \\
p &= P(X = x).
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-system}

Unnumbered display math has no label:

$$
\det\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 & 5 \\ 4 & 4 & 6 \\ 9 & 8 & 1 \end{pmatrix} = 42.
$$

## Theorems and Proofs

::: {#thm-euler}
## Euler's identity

$e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$.
:::

@thm-euler is proved in @sec-app-proofs. Lemmas (`#lem-`), corollaries (`#cor-`),
propositions (`#prp-`), definitions (`#def-`), examples (`#exm-`) and remarks work the
same way.
